messages.content: What behavior does the Click pull request propose for quitting less in follow mode, and is this documented behavior accepted or still unresolved?

The Click pull request proposes documenting that to quit `less` in follow mode (`-f`), users should press `Ctrl+X` then `q`, and that pressing `Ctrl+C` will propagate to Click and quit the command as well [9904cefb-c573-455a-b2f5-eef7623d52c2]. This behavior is not accepted; the decision status is "unresolved" and the review status is "needs_review" [e3490b1e-d71c-493e-87a4-d83407ad297d].
